## Hinge question {#fm2-hinge .fm-slide }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge fm-hinge"><p class="hinge-question">$2400 is invested at 6% p.a. simple interest for nine months. Which calculation gives the <strong>interest earned</strong>?</p><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span><span data-math="2400(0.06)(9)">2400(0.06)(9)</span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span><span data-math="2400(6)(9/12)">2400(6)(9/12)</span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span><span data-math="2400(0.06)(9/12)">2400(0.06)(9/12)</span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span><span data-math="2400[1+0.06(9/12)]">2400[1+0.06(9/12)]</span></span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly. On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>3. Use the decimal annual rate and express nine months in years.</div></div>
```

::: notes
Additional diagnostic question. Default 60 seconds. Students begin with a fist on their chest, think independently, and show 1–4 fingers simultaneously on your verbal “show” cue. Collect responses before revealing. Timer expiry does not reveal the answer.

Correct answer: 3, with interest \$108.
1: treats nine months as nine years.
2: fails to convert 6% to 0.06.
4: calculates the total amount instead of the interest.

Ready: ask what quantity option 4 represents (\$2508 total), then proceed to finding unknown time.
Divided: ask pairs to identify the units of every factor, then re-poll.
Further explanation needed: use a one-year interest amount of \$144 and take three quarters of it; connect this to the formula and re-poll.
:::
